narrative.northStar: 브랜드는 그대로, 마켓은 어른스럽게 — the pinned two-bubbles-make-a-heart brand applied with Daangn/Mercari-grade marketplace restraint
narrative.overview: v1 painted pastel everywhere; v2 pins the brand (heart-O wordmark, bubble chips, blue/pink/coral/navy/ivory) and binds every color to one role. The page is white paper. Navy holds titles, active states, and structure; coral-deep is the single action voice. Blue and pink appear only where a nation speaks (country chips, chat bubbles), and the blue-to-pink bridge gradient survives on exactly one surface, the travel-direct-deal badge. Ivory is no longer paper but a tint marking the trust strip, footer, and search field. Trust is a system concern: the TrustStrip states three facts, every active row carries a safe-pay micro pill, and the footer leaves company/legal slots honestly at '준비 중'. Cards drop to 12px with 10px thumbs and one navy-tinted shadow step; press feedback is a 0.98 squish; the wordmark heartbeat is the only perpetual motion and carousels are native scroll-snap.
keyCharacteristics: White page + navy-tinted ink scale; ivory is a tint (trust strip, footer, search), never paper
One role per color: navy = structure, coral-deep = action, blue/pink = nation
Card 12px, thumb 10px, pills full-round; cards carry one shadow step and no border
Wordmark heartbeat is the only perpetual motion; carousels are native scroll-snap
Price is loudest (800 tabular), titles stay 400; Pretendard tops out at 17px

rules.name: The One-Role Rule
rules.body: Each color has one job. Navy = titles, active states, structure. Coral-deep = the single CTA voice and sell FAB. Blue/pink = country chips and chat bubbles. Ivory = tint. A color doing two jobs on one screen breaks the hierarchy.

rules.name: The Bridge Rule (v2)
rules.body: The blue-to-pink gradient (.grad-bridge-soft) appears on exactly one surface: the travel-direct-deal badge. It never becomes a banner, card, or header field.

rules.name: The Ivory-Is-Tint Rule
rules.body: Ivory (#FBF9F4) marks a differently-natured region on the white page: TrustStrip, SiteFooter, and the search input. It is not the page or card background.

rules.name: The No-Gray Rule
rules.body: There is no achromatic gray. Every neutral, border, shadow, scrim, and scrollbar is navy-tinted (rgba(12,68,124,…)); skeletons shimmer in warm ivory.

rules.name: The Deep-Ink-On-Tint Rule
rules.body: Pastel fields never carry pastel text: blue takes navy, pink takes rose, and white text sits only on coral-deep or navy fills.

rules.name: The Price-Loudest Rule
rules.body: On any commerce surface price is the heaviest text (800, tabular-nums); titles stay 400. For foreign items the buyer-currency conversion is the big number and the seller's original is 12px/700 ink-soft.

rules.name: The 17-Ceiling Rule
rules.body: The largest Pretendard step is the 17px/800 section title. Anything bigger belongs to the Cafe24 wordmark, not the body face.

rules.name: The Two-Tongue Rule
rules.body: Hints, empty states, and the footer tagline speak both languages in one breath, Korean first, joined by a middle dot.

rules.name: The Tinted-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is navy-tinted (the FAB float adds a half-strength coral halo). Pure-black rgba shadows do not exist.

rules.name: The One-Step Rule
rules.body: Cards carry --shadow-soft alone. No border-plus-shadow, no stacked shadow steps. Grid and carousel cards carry no shadow at all; the thumbnail is the surface.

dos: Do keep the page white and use ivory only as the TrustStrip, SiteFooter, and search-input tint.
Do let navy carry titles/active/structure and coral-deep carry action; one coral-deep CTA per screen.
Do signal country/language only with .bubble-kr/.bubble-jp chips and chat-bubble tints.
Do set prices in 800 + .tnum with titles at 400; the buyer-currency number is the big one.
Do use 12px cards, 10px thumbs, full-round pills/chips/badges, and .press/.btn/.card states on everything tappable.
Do keep trust UI factual (TrustStrip, safe-pay pill, footer) and leave missing values as '준비 중'.
Do build horizontal lists as native snap-x snap-mandatory rows of 140px cards, never a JS carousel.
donts: Don't use blue/pink as backgrounds, banners, or section fills; they exist only in country chips and chat bubbles.
Don't use the bridge gradient anywhere but the travel-direct-deal badge.
Don't introduce achromatic grays, black shadows, card borders, flags, or sharp corners.
Don't use Cafe24 Ssurround for section titles, prices, or body; wordmark only.
Don't set Pretendard headings above 17px or any text below 11px.
Don't add a perpetual animation beyond the wordmark heartbeat.
Don't invent trust numbers, reviews, transaction stats, or company/legal details.
